page_topic_one_liner: URL optimization — canonical tags, 301 redirects, hreflang, parameter handling, and duplicate URL consolidation
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional URL canonicalization SEO education, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must show duplicate URL variants merging into one canonical path via 301 arrows and rel=canonical tag — NOT an AI citation-ID chat panel.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Fan-in merge diagram — 4 duplicate URL variant bars (www/non-www, trailing slash, HTTP/HTTPS, ?param= variants) converging via accent 301 redirect arrows into single clean canonical URL bar /seo/url-optimization with rel=canonical link tag snippet floating above
Secondary: tier signal strength ladder — 301 redirect (strongest, solid), canonical tag (medium, dashed), robots block (weakest, dotted)
Tertiary: before/after URL bar comparison showing messy query-string URL vs clean readable slug
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is URL canonicalization not GEO)
Generic link chain without duplicate-merge concept
AI citation ID or Perplexity source panel
